pages.text: Your people belong to $(thing)cultures$(0), each shaped by the climate it calls home: $(thing)Temperate$(0), $(thing)Subarctic$(0), $(thing)Desert$(0), $(thing)Tropical$(0), $(thing)Steppe$(0) and $(thing)Mountain$(0).$(br2)Every culture has its own ladder of eight $(thing)classes$(0), with its own foods, clothes, buildings and rites. Class measures $(thing)wealth and comfort$(0), not your tech era: even a stone-age settlement can raise elites, if you can supply the luxuries.

Each ladder is a $(thing)diamond$(0).$(br2)Everyone starts as a $(thing)newcomer$(0) and becomes a $(thing)worker$(0). Workers branch into three $(thing)specialists$(0): a defender, a maker and a keeper of rites and remedies. Specialists rise into two $(thing)elites$(0), and the elites into a single $(thing)leader$(0).$(br2)Each step up needs the citizen to $(thing)aspire$(0) to that path, which usually means handing it a particular item, such as a sword, a saw or a silver ingot.
